h1.h1-text: RAG development services: what retrieval-augmented generation is,

hero.hero-sub: Retrieval-augmented generation is the architecture behind every AI system that needs to answer accurately from your own data instead of guessing from general training knowledge. I design and build production RAG systems: document ingestion, retrieval engineering, generation, guardrails, and deployment.
hero.live: Every answer traces to a source, guardrails included from day one
